scope: Concise original level-75 Mythic acquisition chain, required hand-ins and missing Dancer Mythic pages. No later weapon upgrades.

articles.title: Mythic Weapon Acquisition at 75
articles.intro: The complete four-quest route from a Nyzul weapon to an awakened level-75 Mythic.
articles.body_html:
Choose the correct path

Unlocking a Myth unlocks a weapon skill. Building the finished weapon instead uses the four quests below. These are separate objectives.

Before starting

Complete the Treasures of Aht Urhgan story through Eternal Mercenary, earn Captain Wildcat Badge through Promotion: Captain, and obtain Runic Key from Nyzul floor 100. Acquire your job’s base weapon from Nyzul Isle Investigation.

Quest order

StageWhat you doNext result
An Imperial HeistRegister the weapon and obtain eight boss titles.Paparoon’s assignment
Duties, Tasks, and DeedsFinish the currency and second Assault clear requirements.Paparoon’s sealed invitation
Forging a New MythTrade the three ZNM trophies, then pass the Zahak/Balrahn battlefield.Serpentking Zahak relief shard
Coming Full CircleAwaken the weapon at the tombstone and finish the palace/Naja scenes.Finished level-75 Mythic

Open Mythic Weapons for the job-to-weapon table. Dancer uses Main Gauche → Terpsichore; Scholar uses Elder Staff → Tupsimati. Level-80+, Magian and item-level upgrades are outside this guide.

Zenith status: original level-75 reference route. The complete weapon-building quest chain has not been verified as playable on Zenith. Do not assume that having these wiki pages means the NPC hand-ins or final battlefield are installed.

articles.title: An Imperial Heist
articles.intro: Register a Nyzul weapon and prove the required eight boss victories.
articles.body_html:
Requirements

Treasures of Aht Urhgan story completed; Captain Wildcat Badge; Runic Key; your chosen job’s Nyzul/Vigil weapon.

Steps

  1. Enter Salaheem’s Sentinels in Aht Urhgan Whitegate (I-10) for the opening scene.
  2. Talk to Abquhbah and trade the base weapon for the Mythic you intend to build. He requires the Runic Key.
  3. Acquire the eight titles listed below. Previously earned titles count; they need not be your currently displayed title.
  4. Return to Naja Salaheem after all objectives are credited. Continue to Duties, Tasks, and Deeds.

Required victories

Gurfurlur the MenacingHalvungTroll Subjugator

Armored ChariotArrapago RemnantsSun Charioteer

Defeat beastman kings in their strongholds; Besieged kills do not award the required credit. Use each enemy’s page for access keys and route. The alternative beastking battlefields added to retail in 2024 are not the original 75-era method.

articles.title: Duties, Tasks, and Deeds
articles.intro: Submit Alexandrite, two purchased relics, and a fresh record of all 50 Assaults.
articles.body_html:
Requirements

An Imperial Heist completed; five free inventory slots for the Assault records.

Steps

  1. Speak to Paparoon beneath the archway in Nashmau (G-7). Read all assignment options and receive the five Assault records.
  2. Complete the four objectives below in any order. Turn in progress to Paparoon.
  3. For each Assault, win and trade the matching record to the Rune of Release before leaving. All 50 normal Assaults must be recorded after receiving these records; your earlier Captain clears are not a substitute.
  4. Return all five fully marked records and the two purchased items, and finish the Alexandrite total.
  5. Speak to Paparoon again for Paparoon’s sealed invitation. Continue to Forging a New Myth.

Required totals

ObjectiveAmountSource / hand-in
Alexandrite30,000Salvage; trade the currency to Paparoon.
Balrahn's Eyepatch100,000 Therion IchorPurchase from Kilusha in Nashmau (H-7).
Wyrmseeker Areuhat150,000 Nyzul TokensPurchase from Zasshal in Whitegate (K-9).
Five Assault records50 distinct Assault winsTrade the appropriate record at each Rune of Release.

Record by Assault area

Inventory nameFull item nameArea
Leujaoam LogLeujaoam Observation LogLeujaoam Sanctum
Mamool Ja JournalMamool Ja Battle JournalMamool Ja Training Grounds
Lebros ChronicleLebros Exploration ChronicleLebros Cavern

Changing the selected weapon can erase this quest’s contributed currency and records. Choose the intended weapon before making these hand-ins. This guide uses the standard 30,000 Alexandrite requirement; no reduced Zenith cost has been confirmed.

articles.title: Forging a New Myth
articles.intro: Obtain the sealed Mythic weapon, then pass the Zahak and Balrahn trial.
articles.body_html:
Requirements

Duties, Tasks, and Deeds completed; Paparoon’s sealed invitation; all three trophies below. Use the job that can equip your Mythic.

Before the battlefield

  1. Examine the Imperial Whitegate palace door in Aht Urhgan Whitegate. Receive the sealed Mythic weapon and one Imperial Gold Piece.
  2. Collect the three tier-four Zeni Notorious Monsters trophies below. Trade them together to Seaprince's Tombstone at the cemetery in Caedarva Mire (E-10), reached from Nashmau’s west exit.
  3. Receive the Serpentking Zahak relief. Travel to the Nyzul Isle Staging Point and choose Forging a New Myth at the Runic Seal (I-9).
TrophyEnemyZone
Tinnin's FangTinninWajaom Woodlands
Sarameya's HideSarameyaMount Zhayolm
Tyger's TailTygerCaedarva Mire

Battlefield: 30 minutes

  1. Equip the sealed Mythic in its proper weapon slot. RNG and COR need appropriate ammunition. Original battle rules do not permit Trusts.
  2. Against Zahak, land three weapon skills with the required weapon equipped to remove the three heads. Misses do not count; pet Blood Pacts do not replace weapon skills.
  3. When Balrahn appears, let him use your weapon’s Mythic skill first. This enables the trial’s Aftermath sequence, even if you already unlocked that skill.
  4. Use that Mythic weapon skill at 1000–1999 TP for Aftermath 1, at 2000–2999 TP for Aftermath 2, then at 3000 TP for Aftermath 3. Check the effect after each use. Old era guides call these 100%, 200% and 300%.
  5. If a higher Aftermath prevents a lower tier, remove and re-equip the weapon to clear it, then redo the missing tier. Do not rely on reducing Balrahn to zero HP to solve the trial.
  6. Complete the victory scene to receive the Serpentking Zahak relief shard. Continue to Coming Full Circle.

Failure consumes the entry relief; obtain and trade another full trophy set for a retry.

articles.title: Coming Full Circle
articles.intro: Finish the level-75 Mythic and close the imperial quest chain.
articles.body_html:
Requirements

Forging a New Myth cleared; Serpentking Zahak relief shard and the sealed Mythic weapon.

Steps

  1. Return to Seaprince's Tombstone in Caedarva Mire (E-10). Examine it with the Mythic equipped for the scene.
  2. Unequip and trade the sealed weapon to the tombstone. Receive the awakened level-75 weapon.
  3. Keep the awakened weapon in your main inventory. Unequip weapons and examine the Imperial Whitegate palace door for the next scene.
  4. Return to Salaheem’s Sentinels and approach Naja Salaheem to finish. Receive three Imperial Silver Pieces.

This is the end of the level-75 weapon route. The separate Unlocking a Myth quest is how you permanently use its weapon skill with other suitable weapons.

articles.title: Paparoon
articles.intro: Mythic quest turn-ins beneath the archway in Nashmau (G-7).
articles.body_html:
What to do here

After An Imperial Heist, follow Duties, Tasks, and Deeds. Bring five open inventory slots to receive the Assault records. This page documents the original NPC service; Zenith’s full weapon quest remains unverified.

articles.title: Seaprince's Tombstone
articles.intro: Mythic trial and weapon hand-ins at the cemetery in Caedarva Mire (E-10).
articles.body_html:
Route

Leave Nashmau through the west exit and travel to the cemetery.

Hand-ins

During Forging a New Myth, trade Tinnin's Fang, Sarameya's Hide, Tyger's Tail together for the battlefield entry key item. After winning, follow Coming Full Circle to trade and awaken the weapon.

articles.title: Alexandrite
articles.intro: Salvage currency collected for a level-75 Mythic weapon.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Defeat Archaic machinery in original Salvage, or use Cotton/Linen coin purses from its treasure. Alexandrite can also be traded between players.

ContainerAlexandrite per use
Cotton Coin Purse5–20
Linen Coin Purse50–99

Use

Trade a total of 30,000 to Paparoon during Duties, Tasks, and Deeds. Level-99 Salvage II and later retail campaigns are outside this era route.

articles.title: Balrahn's Eyepatch
articles.intro: The Einherjar purchase required for the Mythic quest.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Earn 100,000 Therion Ichor through Einherjar. Buy the eyepatch from Kilusha in Nashmau (H-7) during Duties, Tasks, and Deeds.

Turn in

Trade the eyepatch to Paparoon. This is a quest item, not wearable head armor.

articles.title: Wyrmseeker Areuhat
articles.intro: The Nyzul purchase required for the Mythic quest.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Earn 150,000 tokens through Nyzul Isle Investigation. Buy the book from Zasshal in Aht Urhgan Whitegate (K-9) after receiving Paparoon’s assignment.

Turn in

Trade it to Paparoon during Duties, Tasks, and Deeds. Tokens are distinct from normal Assault points and Imperial Standing.

articles.title: Leujaoam Log
articles.intro: Leujaoam Observation Log for the Mythic Assault record.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Receive this record from Paparoon when starting Duties, Tasks, and Deeds.

How to fill it

Complete all ten normal Leujaoam Sanctum Assaults with the record in your inventory. At the end of each successful mission, trade it to the Rune of Release before leaving. Repeat any missing mission, then hand the completed record to Paparoon.

articles.title: Tinnin's Fang
articles.intro: Tier-four ZNM trophy required for the Mythic battlefield.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Defeat Tinnin in Wajaom Woodlands and obtain this trophy. Follow the enemy page for the pop item and Zeni Notorious Monsters progression.

Use

articles.title: Main Gauche
articles.intro: Dancer level-75 Nyzul dagger: DMG 27, Delay 205.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Possible drop from notorious monsters in Nyzul Isle Investigation. The floor-100 HNM has a guaranteed job-based weapon drop tied to the Runic Disc holder’s job; use Dancer for Main Gauche.

Two uses

GoalQuest
Pyrrhic Kleos with any suitable daggerUnlocking a Myth (Dancer)
Terpsichore level-75 Mythic weaponMythic Weapon Acquisition at 75

Do the weapon-skill unlock before handing the dagger to Abquhbah if you want to use the same copy for both routes.

articles.title: Terpsichore
articles.intro: Dancer level-75 Mythic dagger: DMG 31, Delay 205.
articles.body_html:
Benefits

Improves Step accuracy and Step effects. Uses Pyrrhic Kleos to activate Aftermath: accuracy, attack, or occasional double attacks according to TP tier.

How to obtain

  1. Obtain Main Gauche from Nyzul Isle Investigation.
  2. Complete An Imperial Heist and Duties, Tasks, and Deeds.
  3. Finish Forging a New Myth, then awaken the dagger through Coming Full Circle.

Full requirements and materials: Mythic Weapon Acquisition at 75. This page covers the awakened level-75 weapon, not later upgrades.

articles.title: Unlocking a Myth (Dancer)
articles.intro: Permanently unlock Pyrrhic Kleos without building Terpsichore.
articles.body_html:
Requirements

Dancer level 75 and Main Gauche from Nyzul Isle Investigation.

Steps

  1. Equip Main Gauche in the main hand as Dancer. Talk to Zalsuhm in Muckvix’s Junk Shop, Lower Jeuno (H-9), and accept his offer. If you reject it, change zones and speak again.
  2. Keep Main Gauche in the main hand while earning Weapon Skill Points against experience-yielding enemies. A weapon skill gives one point; closing level-1/2/3 skillchains gives two/three/five.
  3. Reach the point requirement. Under era scaling, your current saved Nyzul floor determines the total below. The reviewed modern server base instead uses 250 unless its era override is enabled.
  4. Trade the dagger to Zalsuhm as Dancer. Once enough points are credited, the completion event permanently unlocks Pyrrhic Kleos. You retain the dagger.

Historical point requirement

Saved floorRequired points
016,000
1–198,000 + 320 × (19 − floor)
20–394,000 + 160 × (39 − floor)
40–592,000 + 80 × (59 − floor)
60–791,000 + 40 × (79 − floor)
80–99500 + 20 × (99 − floor)
100250

The weapon-skill quest has a handler in the reviewed server base. That does not confirm the separate four-quest Mythic weapon-building chain. Zenith’s active era-module setting has not been checked live.

articles.title: Pyrrhic Kleos
articles.intro: Dancer’s Mythic dagger weapon skill: a four-hit physical attack.
articles.body_html:
How to unlock

Complete Unlocking a Myth (Dancer) using Main Gauche. You can then use it as Dancer with a suitable dagger; owning Terpsichore is not required for the permanent unlock.

Use

Skillchain properties: Distortion and Scission. When used with the awakened Terpsichore, it also activates the weapon’s Aftermath. Exact damage modifiers follow Zenith’s installed weapon-skill rules, so modern retail multipliers are not assumed here.
